# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to

  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    work environment for their employees.

# Soul Hearted
# **Eating Disorder Treatment.**

Personalized care designed to support your full recovery journey. Find eating disorder treatment
near you with in-person and virtual programs nationwide. We’re so glad you found us.

[I Need Help][160] [My Loved One Needs Help][161] [I am a Provider][162]
[Woman on beach] [ Play Video ][163]

## You Deserve **Flowers.**

At Alsana, it is our intention to provide a safe, supportive space that allows you to focus on the
brave and beautiful work of healing from your eating disorder. In this soul-hearted process, we
believe all you deserve will unfold before you. We offer a nurturing hand as you cultivate the roots
to grow your recovery. These roots will provide you a solid foundation that allows you to write the
pages of your own recovery story. A story in which you will begin to know your worth. A story in
which every day, you know that you deserve flowers.

## You Deserve **Flowers.**

At Alsana, it is our intention to provide a safe, supportive space that allows you to focus on the
brave and beautiful work of healing from your eating disorder. In this soul-hearted process, we
believe all you deserve will unfold before you. We offer a nurturing hand as you cultivate the roots
to grow your recovery. These roots will provide you a solid foundation that allows you to write the
pages of your own recovery story. A story in which you will begin to know your worth. A story in
which every day, you know that you deserve flowers.

#### Your healthcare go-to-market starts here.

[Book a Demo ][30]
HCP Lookup

### Find and contact any healthcare provider in the US.

Your reps spend hours tracking down a physician and still end up leaving a voicemail with someone
who has no idea who makes decisions. Ampliz gives them a verified email, direct phone, and full
practice data for any provider in the US, filtered by specialty, ownership, and procedure codes.

Executive & Decision Maker Search

### Reach the people who control purchasing, budgets, and operations.

The VP of Operations at a 300-bed hospital is not in your CRM. Ampliz is. Search any title, filter
by seniority, department, facility type, and EHR vendor, and give your reps a direct line to the
person who actually controls the budget.

Hospital & Organization Analytics

### Full account context before you make the first call.

Your reps are walking into accounts with no context on who runs what, what tech they use, or how big
they are. Ampliz gives them the org chart, EHR stack, financial data, bed count, and IDN
relationships before they make the first call.

Data Enrichment Engine

### Your existing list, filled in and verified.

You have a contact list. Probably with missing emails, dead numbers, and people who changed jobs six
months ago. Upload your file and Ampliz returns it fully enriched and verified against 20M+
healthcare contacts in minutes.

NPI Lookup

### Turn an NPI number into a full outreach-ready profile.

You have NPI numbers but nothing attached to them your reps can use. Every match returns a full
outreach-ready profile: specialty, location, email, phone, LinkedIn, procedure codes, and Medicare
claims.

GTM Activation

### Go from verified contacts to active pipeline, without switching tools.

Export directly to HubSpot, Salesforce, or any CRM your team already uses. Or let Ampliz run warm-up
sequences and multi-touch cadences, and hand your reps only the contacts who engaged. No more cold
outbound into a list nobody touched.

and co-occurring eating disorders, mental health, or substance use disorders.

or those suffering from other related eating disorders. We offer well-researched articles to help
you understand the signs and symptoms of various eating disorders, and what type of recovery and
treatment options are available. We also help you better understand how eating disorders are
affected by mental health, and vice versa.

Whether you’re suffering from an eating disorder or know someone who is, we can help you on the road
to recovery and live a healthier life.

  Eating disorders are mental illnesses defined by abnormal dietary habits, such as eating
  excessively small or large amounts of food, that have the potential to cause major physical and
  mental problems. Most common eating disorders are anorexia, bulimia and binge eating disorder.

  individuals.

  ##### [The Impact of Body Dysmorphic Disorder][42]
  
  Eating disorders are mental illnesses defined by abnormal dietary habits, such as eating

### **Your Health & Fitness**

# **STARTS WITH YOU**

### **at Fitness by Design in Indianapolis**

## What Makes Fitness by Design Different?

Unlike most health clubs or gyms, **Fitness by Design** does not sell memberships. We have no
long-term contracts or membership fees. Access to name brand equipment, clean locker rooms, and a
bright open fitness studio area are complimentary. What clients do pay for is **expert fitness
coaching** and **personal training instruction**. Our certified professional trainers conduct a
thorough consultation and screening, and design a healthy workout customized for each individual
that may include:
* Strength Training
* Cardio Training
* Muscle Building
* Functional Fitness
* Sports Performance Training
* [One-On-One Personal Coaching][47]
* [Two-On-One Personal Coaching][48]
* [Small Group Training][49]
* [Yoga, Balance, Movement Classes][50]

Our fitness clients include women and men, youth and seniors, beginners and athletes; and our custom
training programs can be slow and gentle or high intensity - whatever works best for your fitness
objectives, whether you’re a busy mom or a retiree. You purchase a month at a time, or a small
package of workouts - no long-term commitment required!

Our state-of-the-art facility comes equipped with all the workout and exercise equipment that you
need, from Life Fitness, Nautilus, MedX, Hammer, Concept II, Rogue, Keiser, and so much more.
Kettlebells, Medicine balls, Barbells, etc....all with a dedicated personal trainer who will help
you improve your strength, cardiovascular fitness, agility, balance, and metabolism.

We also offer [Personal Nutritional Counseling][51], and have a few unexpected amenities onsite. You
can even get spa-like treatments from an onsite aesthetician and massage therapist.

Whether your goals are to lose weight, gain muscle, improve flexibility, increase endurance,
mobility, athleticism, or something else, take advantage of the opportunity to join a team that will
create custom workout plans and personal training programs to help you grow to your fullest
potential - from the inside, out.

[ Contact us for a free consultation ][52]
[ schedule a free tour ][53]
[ View Pricing or sign up now ][54]

### ATMOSPHERE

At **Fitness by Design**, we will meet you right where you are.

You will feel comfortable in our spacious, professional environment, and we will work with you to
help you reach your personal, individual goals at the rate you set for yourself.

We are the right fit for anyone, from beginners to athletes and fitness pros.

[ LEARN MORE ][55]

### PROCESS

We take the time to have a conversation with you in order to create an individualized plan that will
optimize your health and overall well-being.  

After the plan is set, you will meet your personal trainer and they will help you maximize your
results, providing motivation and accountability on your journey.

[ CONTACT US ][56]

## We are your mental health advocates in New York

We work together to educate and empower our patients in their journey to recovery via in-person
sessions, group therapy, telemedicine, and other methods best suited to each individual patient’s
needs. Compassionate care is a fundamental principle of our practice, starting from first contact
with our staff to personalized sessions with our expert Psychiatrists, Psychotherapists, and Nurse
Practitioners. It is our privilege to help you lead happier, more fulfilling lives.
* [
  Contact Us

## Comprehensive psychiatric and psychotherapy Care

Adult Psychiatry

We diagnose and treat adult patients with psychiatric disorders such as anxiety, ADHD, bipolar
disorder, schizophrenia, sleep disorders, PTSD, SAD, postpartum depression, phobias, eating
disorders, ADD, OCD, anger management, personality disorders, gender dysphoria, and depression and
other conditions.

Child/Adolescent Psychiatry

Our providers specialize in delivering mental health services to children and adolescents, starting
as young as age 7. They are experienced in addressing a wide range of diagnoses unique to young
individuals, offering personalized care to support their emotional and psychological well-being

Psychotherapy

We offer psychotherapy to help patients manage behavior and thought patterns, supporting recovery
through dialogue and a non-judgmental space. Our therapists combine talk therapy with personalized
treatment plans and medication management for improved mental health

## Our featured services

At Good Health Psychiatric Services P.C., we diagnose and treat psychiatric disorders in adults and
children/adolescents using psychotherapy and medication management. Our services include individual,
family, and group therapy, tailored to each patient’s needs. With our main office located in
Downtown Brooklyn, NY, our team of doctors, nurse practitioners, and psychotherapists provides
personalized, compassionate care both in person and via telehealth. Our mission is to prioritize
patients’ health and well-being, enhancing their quality of life.

# **We *Specialize* In:**

### **Whole Health & Wellness**

No gimmicks or fads. Having a Registered Dietitian on your team can help you take your personal
health to the next level— whether you’re focused on **disease prevention **or if you’re managing a
chronic condition like **diabetes** or **high cholesterol**.

### **Relationships With Food**

Food choices don’t have to feel stressful and anxiety-provoking. We’ll guide you in building a truly
healthy and **peaceful relationship with food** while caring for your whole health. You can trust
that our support is always **anti-diet **and** weight-inclusive**.

### **GLP-1 Support**

Anyone prescribed a GLP-1 medication should have dietitian support to ensure that they are
**nourishing their body** and **managing side effects**. We’ll help you find an eating style that
supports your **short-term and long-term health**.

### **Disordered Eating & Eating Disorders**

If you are struggling with patterns of behavior like restrictive eating, overeating and binge
eating, or hyper-fixation on food decisions, you’ve come to the right place. We’ll support you in
your **recovery journey**.

## We know it’s on you to hold this all together.

You need to keep everything running. But your business and customers treat integration complexity
like someone else's problem.

The environment multiplies.

Another platform. Another process or API change. Another ‘quick integration’ that isn't.

Things get more complex.

Everything’s connected, demand is relentless. One system fails, everything stops.

Constant change.

Business wants speed and cost-efficiency. Clients want reliability. Integrations weren't built for
both.

Zero margin for error.

Every integration adds fragility. Every failure costs trust.

## What do you get with our 360° creative agency subscription?

### Unlimited requests and flexible scaling

Submit unlimited requests within your chosen service areas. We'll tackle them sequentially, working
on as many requests simultaneously as possible on your subscription plan. Need more capacity? Simply
add workstreams to scale your resources as projects demand.

### Full ownership and transparency

Receive complete ownership of all deliverables produced during our engagement, including source
files, research data, and implementation code. You'll also have access to premium tools, licenses,
and frameworks that power our solutions.

### No-obligation flexibility

Use our subscription for as long as you need and cancel anytime with no hidden fees or penalties.
Your subscription simply won't renew for the following month. Annual plans offer additional savings
while maintaining the same flexibility.

### Senior expertise at exceptional value

Access the top 0.5% of talent across design, conversion optimization and AI for a fraction of
traditional agency costs. From premium creative work to data-driven optimization and automation,
receive senior-level expertise without the price tag.

### Seamless integration

We adapt to your preferred workflow with dedicated project management. Whether you prefer ClickUp,
Slack, email, or your own project management tools, we'll integrate seamlessly with your team's
existing processes.

### Rapid, reliable delivery

Experience industry-leading turnaround times across all service areas. Typically, you'll receive
updates every 1-3 working days (depending on complexity), ensuring continuous progress on your
initiatives without unnecessary delays.

# Expert Eating Disorder Treatment

## Family-owned for 40 years

[Learn About Renfrew][95]

## Healing Through Community,
## Eating Disorder Recovery Starts Here.

Family-owned since 1985, The Renfrew Center is a trusted leader in eating disorder treatment, where
healing feels personal and community runs deep. We have guided more than 100,000 adolescent girls,
women, transgender, and non-binary individuals to recovery from anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa,
binge-eating disorder, ARFID, and other eating disorders through compassionate, evidence-based
programs.  

If concerned about the cost of treatment, know that Renfrew has a full team that partners with
insurance companies to work on behalf of you to navigate the cost of care.  

As the only treatment facility utilizing the research-backed Unified Treatment Model for Eating
Disorders®, Renfrew integrates proven therapies, including cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT),
dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), and nutrition therapy, into one comprehensive approach to
recovery**.** 

We honor each person’s unique story and empower them to actively participate in their own recovery,
enriched by connection with others.

residential treatment to outpatient programs and support groups – we offer an environment where

## A Great Therapist Changes Everything: Online or in-person.

We are a network of licensed and professional clinical counselors, therapists, and psychologists who
strive to make mental health care safe, affordable, and accessible. We hold compassionate values in
therapy that cares for the whole person. Our goal is to help people reach their potential, overcome
difficult journeys, and effect real and lasting change. We maintain strong academic rigor, as
therapists on Theravive hold advanced degrees and are required to be fully licensed to practice
counseling. Our purpose is to connect you to the right professional, giving you a better direction,
attainable goals, and a clearer understanding of how to get there. Our therapists specialize in
every form of counseling, including relationships, anxiety, trauma / PTSD, depression, families,
career change, addictions, children, eating disorders, couples, and marriages. If you are seeking
help for your family, a loved one, your marriage, or an issue in your own life, please enter your
zip code or city to start your therapist or psychologist search and begin your path to healing
today.

Our mission is to provide values-based counselors and resources to individuals, couples, and
families for lasting change.  Our specialized approach to counselling results in an effective and
powerful system aimed at truly resolving issues and restoring brokenness, returning individuals,
families, and loved ones to a life of greater purpose and meaning- a life that is full of hope,
having a clear path to a brighter future.

## A Great Therapist Changes Everything: Online or in-person.

We are a network of licensed and professional clinical counselors, therapists, and psychologists who
strive to make mental health care safe, affordable, and accessible. We hold compassionate values in
therapy that cares for the whole person. Our goal is to help people reach their potential, overcome
difficult journeys, and effect real and lasting change. We maintain strong academic rigor, as
therapists on Theravive hold advanced degrees and are required to be fully licensed to practice
counseling. Our purpose is to connect you to the right professional, giving you a better direction,
attainable goals, and a clearer understanding of how to get there. Our therapists specialize in
every form of counseling, including relationships, anxiety, trauma / PTSD, depression, families,
career change, addictions, children, eating disorders, couples, and marriages. If you are seeking
help for your family, a loved one, your marriage, or an issue in your own life, please enter your
zip code or city to start your therapist or psychologist search and begin your path to healing
today.

## Better And More Effective Therapy

Our mission is to provide values-based counselors and resources to individuals, couples, and
families for lasting change.  Our specialized approach to counselling results in an effective and
powerful system aimed at truly resolving issues and restoring brokenness, returning individuals,
families, and loved ones to a life of greater purpose and meaning- a life that is full of hope,
having a clear path to a brighter future.

On Jan. 14, 2026, UT Southwestern became aware of a privacy incident involving the Care Everywhere
health information exchange (HIE). In December 2025, vendors SelfRx, Ravilla, GuardDog, and Mammoth
accessed patient information beyond their authorized scope without a valid treatment, payment, or
healthcare operations purpose. The information varied by individual and may have included name,
address, date of birth, medication information, and treatment history. It did not include credit
card numbers or other financial account information. At this time, there is no evidence the
information was further disclosed, misused, or retained.

UTSW took immediate steps to terminate unauthorized access, secure affected systems, identify and
notify impacted individuals, and implement additional safeguards, including enhanced access
controls, monitoring, and oversight of HIE activity. No action is required at this time. As a
precaution, we encourage you to review healthcare statements and communications and report any
concerns. Imp [ Skip Navigation ][1]

## The Spark of Innovation

Our mission of discovery and healing comes alive every day in the research labs, classrooms, and
clinical spaces all across our campus in Dallas-Fort Worth. That’s where some of the brightest minds
in science and medicine are following their spark and connecting the dots between bold ideas and
tangible, lifesaving treatments for our patients.

[Learn More][88]

**Patient Notification**

UT Southwestern Medical Center is notifying affected patients of a privacy incident involving
patient information in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
(HIPAA), as some individuals could not be reached by mail.

On Jan. 14, 2026, UT Southwestern became aware of a privacy incident involving the Care Everywhere
health information exchange (HIE). In December 2025, vendors SelfRx, Ravilla, GuardDog, and Mammoth
accessed patient information beyond their authorized scope without a valid treatment, payment, or
healthcare operations purpose. The information varied by individual and may have included name,
address, date of birth, medication information, and treatment history. It did not include credit
card numbers or other financial account information. At this time, there is no evidence the
information was further disclosed, misused, or retained.

UTSW took immediate steps to terminate unauthorized access, secure affected systems, identify and
notify impacted individuals, and implement additional safeguards, including enhanced access
controls, monitoring, and oversight of HIE activity. No action is required at this time. As a
precaution, we encourage you to review healthcare statements and communications and report any
concerns. Impacted individuals can contact our dedicated call center at [833-445-1229][89]. We
deeply regret the occurrence of this incident and any worry, distress, or difficulty that it may
cause. We appreciate the trust you place in UT Southwestern for your healthcare.
